title: Chapter 462
text:
Clang clang clang!

In less than two minutes, the Amphiptere mecha under Philip's control had taken care of this group of thick-skinned rock golem warriors. The group of rock golems lay on the ground, groaning weakly in pain.

These thugs were only Grade C, and with the enhancement of Han Xiao's mechanical suit, these enemies were easily defeated.

"No — my smooth skin!" The leader of the rock warriors looked at his cracked body and wailed. In the rock people's eyes, the texture of the rock on the surface of the body was the same as the face. The most beautiful were naturally crystals, diamonds, and other minerals. If it was a normal rock that was as smooth as a pebble, then it would be a handsome man.

To a rock person, having cracks all over their body was equivalent to being disfigured. Even if the rock people could digest rocks to heal their wounds, it would still take a long time for them to recover.

At this time, this big guy was crying. It made people want to beat him up again.

"Your strength is about the same as mine, and you want to teach us a lesson? Who gave you the courage?! "The Volga boss's face was full of disdain.

The weakness of the rock warriors also made Han Xiao feel a little strange. It was impossible for the employer to not know their strength. What could they do by sending this group of weaklings? Was it just a warning or a greeting gift? Or was he wrong? Was the employer not the target they were looking for?

Matters involving the Prophet were always a headache. Han Xiao did not dwell on it. He grabbed the rock warrior and asked directly, "Who is your employer?"

Logically speaking, mercenaries would not betray their employer's identity. He was already prepared to force a confession, but he did not expect the rock warrior's answer to surprise him.

"Oh, the employer asked us to come here today to deal with the person who pressed the doorbell of the villa. He also said that our lives would not be in danger. If we lose, he will tell you a location and ask you to go there to find a person. Someone there knows his whereabouts," the rock warrior said nervously. The rock warrior said nervously, "He also said that you would interrogate the identity of the employer. He told me to pass on his original words — 'You guessed right, it's me. Don't think I don't know that you've used my name. If you want to find me, then play a game with me.'"

Everyone's expression changed.

"Damn it, Prophet!" Han Xiao gritted his teeth.

Herlous slapped Han Xiao's back, and a loud thud was heard. He looked up and laughed. "Hahaha, you've met someone of the same trade!"

"Peers hate peers the most." Han Xiao snorted and asked for the location. The Rock Warrior trembled as he told him the next location. It was in the north of City Eight. From here, they would have to cross the entire city.

Standing up, Han Xiao rubbed his chin and pondered. The Prophet had hired these Rock Warriors to pass on clues and direct them to the next location.

The target had purposely left his whereabouts sixteen days ago and used his prophecy ability to spy on their movement time. From there, he knew that they would arrive at this place today and thus set up the Rock Warriors. The prophecy ability was not omniscient and could not be used casually. It required some inducement, and the clues that the target had purposely left for the intelligence organization were naturally this inducement.

He could break the prophecy and kill these Rock Warriors here, but the problem was, was this also part of the Prophet's plan? The other party had purposely told him that the Rock Warriors were not dangerous to trigger his rebellious mentality. Actually, the other party wanted him to kill these Rock Warriors and attract the attention of the security team … Was it even possible that the Prophet had seen through his thoughts? Maybe the other party had used his personality to say that the Rock Warriors were absolutely safe?

"That's why I hate Prophets." Han Xiao's head hurt.

Even though he already knew about the Dragon Emperor's ability, this feeling of being led by the nose still made Han Xiao very depressed.

Prophets were good at using their abilities to play tricks. To a sufficiently powerful Prophet, the level of intelligence did not matter. The wise and the foolish were just pawns used in different ways. When you thought you were very smart, you did not know that the Prophet had already used your 'intelligence'. You had no idea what kind of action the Prophet really wanted you to take.

Thankfully, Han Xiao had his own advantages. He knew the target's ability and personality very well, so he could use the Prophet's way of thinking to judge the other party's thoughts. He could not guarantee that he would be able to escape from the trap, but at least he would not fall for it. Furthermore, based on his understanding of the target, although the other party's personality was bad, he did not have much malice.

This was good news. After all, although the Prophet did not have much power, it would be a very, very, very headache to make an enemy out of him!

"What do we do? Are we going to the location he said?" Herlous asked.

"Let's go see what he's up to."

Han Xiao snapped his fingers and created a Mechanical Force spark. The Amphiptere mechanical suit instantly turned into a compressed orb and attached itself to the necklace.

At the same time, Mechanical Force spread out from his feet and connected to the damaged robot parts. These parts suddenly floated in the air, gathered together, and quickly assembled under the control of Mechanical Force. Some of the metal parts that had been deformed in the explosion returned to their original shape under the effect of the Mechanical Force field. In a breath's time, this pile of damaged parts turned back into the round robot body.

Basic Mechanical Construction + Waste Modification!

The round little robot moved again. Philip waved his mechanical arm, slid to Han Xiao's feet, and reported, "Automatic maintenance in progress, hum … performance reduced by twenty-five percent, hum … stored data backed up, hum …"

Sylvia's eyes sparkled as if stars had jumped out. "Teacher, I want to learn this!"

"You want to run when you haven't even learned how to walk?"

Han Xiao glanced at her and retracted the mechanical bug that he had secretly sent out not long ago to scout the villa. After confirming that there was no one in the villa, he turned around and walked away. "There are no more clues here. Let's go."

The group left this secluded street, leaving behind a group of stone people lying on the ground and screaming.

…

At the same time, in a secret location in Noriose City No. 4, a group of dark figures gathered in a dark room.

Many Dark-star members were gathered in this dimly lit room. Secret operations always liked to be stationed in dark places like this.

"The intelligence has been organized. The traitor appeared in the center of City No. 7, the northwest of City No. 6, and the station of City No. 4 at the same time. His ability is to create five physical doppelgangers. One of them is in our hands, the other three have been exposed, and the last one is missing. It should be his main body that is hiding. His doppelganger can't be too far away from his main body, or he won't be able to maintain it. The exact distance is unknown, but it shouldn't be more than a planet, so he's still in Noriose, "a Dark-star soldier said.

In the corner of the room, a Godora person was tied tightly to a chair, dripping with blood. It was unknown how much torture he had suffered. He looked exactly like Ovenn, and there was a mocking sneer on his face.

"What are you laughing at?" a Dark-star soldier shouted.

"Hehehe, you'll never catch my main body."

Ovenn was the traitor that Dark-star was tracking. His ability was to create doppelgangers, and the one that Dark-star had caught was one of his doppelgangers.

If Han Xiao were here, he would most likely think of Black Spider, who was in prison on Blue Star's Bell of Death Island. Both of them had doppelganger-type abilities, but the specific effects were different. Black Spider's doppelgangers were puppets, and he could only perform simple control. His consciousness could only exist in one puppet at a time, but it could be transferred. As long as the doppelganger was alive, he would not die.

However, Ovenn was different. He could at most have five doppelgangers at a time, and each doppelganger had a complete combat ability. His consciousness could be divided into five, and these doppelgangers were all him and could move at the same time. One of the doppelgangers was the main body, and because of the shared senses, if the doppelganger was injured or killed, the main body's consciousness would also be affected. Furthermore, if the doppelganger was too far away from the main body, it would collapse, which was equivalent to death.

Therefore, as long as he controlled one of the doppelgangers, he could determine the approximate location of the main body. Ovenn was still hiding in Noriose.

A soldier suddenly said, "Captain Fausthod, the latest news shows that the doppelganger in City No. 4 took the train to City No. 8. Vice-captain Sherman did not act according to plan …"

"I got it." Fausthod replied indifferently. He was a mixed-blood Godora, a Grade B Super of Dark-star, and the captain of this hunting team.

… At least, he was the captain on the surface.

After looking at the intelligence report for a while, Fausthod walked out of the room. Outside was a long corridor, and after turning two corners, he walked into an empty room. He touched the wall and pressed a disguised button. The wall slid open silently, and the cross-section was an alloy door. Inside was actually a secret room.

He walked in, and there were only two people inside. They were Anur and Ashes.

This time, Dark-star had not only mobilized a large number of elite soldiers, a total of seven Grade B Supers, but also two Calamity Grade Supers, Anur and Ashes. It could be said that they had mobilized a lot of troops!

Dark-star hated this traitor to the core. Ovenn had leaked a portion of Dark-star's internal information to Godora, causing a Grade A member of the organization, Vimla, to fall into a trap while carrying out a mission. After a bloody battle, he was captured by Godora and imprisoned in the Rainbow Prison. Furthermore, Ovenn had even more information in his hands. If this information was leaked, Godora would have a better understanding of them. This was a huge threat.

Dark-star would not allow traitors to survive. Now that the team had trapped Ovenn in Noriose, it was a game of cat and mouse, and they would find him sooner or later. Therefore, the information would not be leaked out for the time being. If Ovenn wanted to live, he could only rely on reinforcements. If he handed over all the information, he would no longer have any value to Godora. This was a matter of life and death, and promises could not be trusted. Therefore, he did not dare hand over all the information and had to use it to threaten Godora to send reinforcements.

Dark-star was also very clear about this point. Due to the uniqueness of Noriose, neither Dark-star nor Godora would send out battleships to surround the planet. This financial group had deep connections and many Star Cluster Civilizations. If both parties wanted to capture Ovenn, they could only send out their own Supers to act on the planet.

"Your Excellencies." Fausthod stepped forward and bowed respectfully. "We have new information. One of the traitor's doppelgangers took the train to City 8, and Sherman did not act according to plan."

Anur asked with a deep voice, "Why?"

"He accidentally met the Black Star Mercenary on the train!" Fausthod said. "Ovenn sat at the same table as them. Sherman did not have the confidence to take action and did not dare to act."

"Black Star?" Anur frowned and looked at Ashes. He still remembered that Ashes was obsessed with Black Star and said with a deep voice, "The mission is more important. The enemy is out in the open, and we are in the dark. There is no need to provoke him."

Hearing this name, Ashes' expression did not change. To him, this name had become a meaningless passerby. His mood did not change, and his tone was indifferent.

"Don't worry, I did not put him in my eyes long ago. The traitor is our target. As long as Black Star does not interfere with our matters, he can live."

"Not bad." A gratified look flashed past Anur's eyes, but it disappeared in an instant.

He said with a serious expression, "Sherman's decision is correct. Behind Black Star is Dragon Emperor Ames. Do not create unnecessary problems. Ovenn is lucky to have met this group of mercenaries, but his luck will not last forever. Let Sherman continue to track him …
